messages:
Alex M.: Heads up — planning a canary for the batching optimization (batchOptV2) this afternoon. Goal: reduce tokens/sec cost while keeping median p50 latency < 120ms. Who can own the deploy+smoke? :eyes:

Maya R.: I can take deploy. Targeting 10:30 PDT. Will push config flag and start with tiny cohorts.

Liam K.: Thx Maya. Proposed ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% over ~45m with 10m watch windows. Rollback if error-rate > 0.8% or p50 >= 150ms for two consecutive windows.

Sara P.: Add these smoke checks: quick gen perf, KV cache hit rate, and tail latency. I wrote a tiny smoke script:```
# smoke.sh
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/test-gen -d '{"prompt":"Hello world","flag":"batchOptV2=true"}' | jq '.latency_ms'
```Run that from two regions.

Maya R.: Good checklist. I'll annotate deploy steps in the runbook and put the feature flag rollout in the console. Will start at 10:30 PDT in us-west-2.

Ryan (oncall): I'll watch alerts and be ready to pause traffic. Please @me when you flip the 5% -> 20% jump.

Alex M.: Cohort selection: use geo-slice A (west-us) for 1% and 5%, then mix in geo-slice B (east-us) for 20%. Keep enterprise customers pinned to the old variant until 60% completes.

Liam K.: Agreed. Add metric gates: if embeddings QPS drops or service error rates increase, automatic rollback. I'll put a temporary dashboard.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Maya R. at 2026-03-17T17:30:00Z — canary cohorts: [1%, 5%, 20%, 60%]. Status: queued.

Maya R.: Deploy started. flipping flag for cohort 1% now. smoke script: PASS (median 95ms, errors 0.1%).

Alex M.: Nice. Proceed to 5% after 10m if no regressions.

Maya R.: 5% -> smoke PASS. moving to 20% in 2m. tagging @Ryan (oncall) before jump. :thumbsup:

Ryan (oncall): Watching. No alerts so far.

Maya R.: 20% -> smoke PASS. p50 110ms, errors 0.15%, KV hit stable. proceeding to 60% after our hold window.

Liam K.: I'll monitor aggregated latency histograms and token cost delta. Looks within expected.

Alex M.: Thanks team — proceeding to full rollout after 60% steady for 15m. Leave notes in the release thread with rollback triggers and rollback owner (Maya). :white_check_mark:
